responsibility: Provides the public C/C++ interface for the IQ2000 backend implementation in iq2000.cc and its machine description helpers. It declares target routines for frame layout and elimination offsets, prologue/epilogue and EH return expansion, delay-slot filling, move and branch output, address legitimacy checks, argument and return-value handling, and RTL branch-generation helpers, so other backend-generated and target headers can reference these services consistently.
